purpose: Test whether the existing cheap Joel idiolect proxy can safely predict Pangram-4 Human status well enough to skip detector calls, using existing detector evidence only.

proxy.candidate_rule_family: safe iff both channel similarities exceed training thresholds
proxy.threshold_selection: leave-one-experiment-group-out; maximize training coverage subject to zero training false-safe cases

profile.note: Five Love4Nanou relationship/personal posts plus the pre-ChatGPT TAFKA true-love post. Individual Love4Nanou sources are thin but combined profile exceeds 1,000 words. The TAFKA source carried the existing generic possible-unremoved-dialogue quality flag, so this remains a pilot rather than a clean profile-validation dataset.

dataset.detector_evidence: Six exact Pangram-4 cached results plus durable exact high-confidence Pangram-4 case-study endpoints; no detector remeasurement.

leave_one_group_out.interpretation: The only way the predeclared zero-training-false-safe threshold family avoided false-safe held-out cases was to abstain on every eligible held-out example. It therefore saved zero Pangram calls.

key_counterexamples.comparison: More surface-similar to the natural-owner profile than Human P_A0B0 (0.767633) and the Human endpoint (0.753331).
Very close in content-light similarity to the Human endpoint (0.979453); idiolect retention does not separate these detector outcomes.
Highest content-light similarity in the pilot despite being high-confidence AI in the durable case record.
The AI endpoint is more surface-similar to Joel than the owner Human rewrite; content-light is nearly identical.

love4nanou_only_profile_run.note: The prior run completed scoring before correctly failing the >=1000-profile-word post-run quality gate. It independently showed the same zero-coverage direction but is not primary evidence.

validation.decision: Do not use the current idiolect-retention proxy to skip Pangram. The pilot provides no usable safe-call coverage and contains direct counterexamples to monotonic idiolect-similarity => Pangram-Human reasoning.

anti_erasure_interpretation.still_useful_for: Directional evidence about movement toward or away from Joel's reference profile when the boundary and corpus are meaningful.
anti_erasure_interpretation.not_useful_for: Certifying detector-Human status or replacing Pangram under the current instrument/evidence.
anti_erasure_interpretation.production_rule: Keep idiolect preservation as a process objective and optional drift diagnostic; keep Pangram as a separate detector axis when detector certification is required.
